attractions.name: Jacobite Steam Train & Glenfinnan Viaduct Day Tour
attractions.description: Guided full-day excursion through valleys, lochs and Highland villages with a ride on the Jacobite Steam Train over the Glenfinnan Viaduct, with stops at Fort William, Mallaig, Glenfinnan Viewpoint and Loch Shiel
tips: Meeting point at 19 Union Street, Inverness; arrive 15 minutes early
Bring a warm jacket, comfortable walking shoes and a backup phone charger
Pack extra snacks or buy at stops
